ImageDescription.value: Horse pasture. A small gap in the vegetation lining Green Lane permits a glimpse of the large horse pasture beside it. Green Lane turns off the B1149, leading east past North Farm > 970935 and Green Lane Farm > 970978 from where it turns into an unsurfaced track which traverses Lodge Hill Larch Plantation > 389008 and Gravelpit Plantation > 557368 passing Heath Farm. A surfaced road again in its easternmost section the lane connects with the A140 by Horsham St Faith.
